title: Utilize a worksheet to prepare the statement of cash flows

items.concept: Period-end WC adjusting worksheet JEs (emphasis); subsequent depreciation and amortization; initial recognition (equipment purchase, stock issuance); disposal (equipment sale) and settlement (bond retirement); complete worksheet → formal indirect SCF
Number-variant twin: reconstruct worksheet entries for period-end WC, depreciation schedule, equipment disposal, note principal settlement, stock issuance; prepare formal SCF

Period-end adjusting worksheet JEs (WC, depreciation, bond premium/discount amortization); disposal of equipment; initial recognition of bonds at a discount; early bond retirement (settlement) — classify each lower-half amount O/I/F
Classification / presentation — lower-half worksheet convention (additions = debits; deductions = credits) for a period-end working-capital reconciling item
